data.name: Biman
data.gender_notes: Biman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Biman is derived from the Sanskrit language. It is composed of two words - 'Bim' meaning mountain and 'An' meaning strong. This name symbolizes strength and stability, reminding one of the unwavering strength of a mountain. It is a powerful name for a baby boy, evoking images of courage and resilience. The name Biman carries the meaning “Strong as Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Biman usually hope their child will grow to embody strong as mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the strength and stability of the divine mountain Meru.
data.etymology: Biman belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong as Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Biman total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
